property_summary: After seedMarket, the initialized flag becomes true.
When seedMarket is called with marketDrugs == 0, it must succeed and set initialized to true.
Any call to seedMarket must succeed if and only if marketDrugs is zero.
The seedMarket call succeeds exactly when marketDrugs was zero before the call.
The seedMarket call succeeds exactly when marketDrugs was zero before the call.
seedMarket succeeds (does not revert) only if marketDrugs was 0 before the call.
seedMarket reverts if and only if marketDrugs is non-zero before the call.
After any seedMarket call, if marketDrugs was non-zero before the call then the call reverts.
seedMarket never sets initialized to true when it reverts
After any call to seedMarket, the reverted status is exactly opposite to whether initialized is true after the call.
After calling seedMarket, initialized must be true only if marketDrugs was initially zero; the bug makes it always true regardless of marketDrugs.

After any call to seedMarket(drugs) that reverts, initialized must remain false; the bug sets it to true even on revert, so a subsequent getFreeKilo() (which requires initialized) succeeds when it should fail.

For any call sequence that reverts in seedMarket (when marketDrugs > 0), initialized must remain false so that collectDrugs/getFreeKilo/sellDrugs remain blocked; the bug sets initialized=true even on revert, so a subsequent call to collectDrugs succeeds when it should revert.
After a call to seedMarket that reverts because marketDrugs > 0, the initialized variable must remain false; the buggy version always sets it true, allowing a subsequent getFreeKilo() to succeed.

For any call sequence that attempts to seed the market when it is already seeded (marketDrugs > 0), the subsequent enabling of collectDrugs via initialized must be blocked; the bug sets initialized=true even on revert, allowing collectDrugs to succeed via a re-entrant referral chain that requires initialized.
Only the CEO designated at construction can successfully change ceoAddress via DrugDealer.
